product_overview: Reservas Hotel Aurora is a minimal hotel booking system that lets guests browse rooms, create reservations, and pay online through PayU Latam sandbox. It also provides reservation management views and JSON APIs for availability, booking records, and payment confirmation.
core_goals: Allow guests to view the three seeded rooms and start a reservation from the catalog
Validate reservation input consistently on client and server before creating a booking
Create reservations with correct nights, pricing, and unique reference codes
Support PayU Latam sandbox checkout with server-generated payment signatures
Confirm or reject payments through PayU webhook and reports-based result handling
Expose read-only APIs for rooms, reservations, and health status
Prevent date conflicts for confirmed reservations while keeping pending reservations non-blocking in the MVP

features.name: Health Check API
features.description: Provides a lightweight liveness endpoint so the system can be monitored and verified as running.
user_flows: GET /api/health with server unavailable -> Receive non-200 error response

features.name: Rooms Catalog API
features.description: Returns the seeded room catalog so guests can browse available room types and their nightly rates.
user_flows: GET /api/rooms -> Receive 200 with the three seeded rooms and their details
GET /api/rooms when the service fails -> Receive non-200 error response

features.name: Reservation Creation and Retrieval API
features.description: Lets guests create reservations with validated input and allows staff or guests to retrieve reservation details by id.
user_flows: POST /api/reservations with valid roomSlug, dates, guest data, and guest count -> Receive 201 with reservation in PENDIENTE_PAGO including noches, totalCop, and referencia -> GET /api/reservations/{id} -> Receive 200 with the stored reservation and room details
POST /api/reservations with invalid fields such as past check-in, bad email, or guests above capacity -> Receive 400 with field-level validation errors
POST /api/reservations with unknown roomSlug -> Receive 404 with {"error":"Habitación no encontrada"}
POST /api/reservations for dates that overlap a CONFIRMADA reservation of the same room -> Receive 409 with {"error":"La habitación ya tiene una reserva confirmada en esas fechas"}
GET /api/reservations/{id} for a missing cuid -> Receive 404 with {"error":"Reserva no encontrada"}

features.name: PayU Confirmation Webhook
features.description: Receives server-to-server payment confirmations from PayU, verifies the signature, and updates reservation payment status and transaction data.
user_flows: POST /api/webhooks/payu with valid form-encoded merchant_id, reference_sale, value, currency, state_pol, sign, and transaction_id -> Receive 200 OK -> Reservation matched by reference_sale is updated with transaction_id and status changes to CONFIRMADA or PAGO_RECHAZADO based on state_pol
POST /api/webhooks/payu with an invalid signature or merchant_id -> Receive 403 Firma inválida and no reservation changes occur
POST /api/webhooks/payu with a reference_sale that does not match any reservation -> Receive 404 Reserva no encontrada
POST /api/webhooks/payu with a non-form-data body -> Receive 400 error response

tech_stack: PayU Latam sandbox (WebCheckout, reports API, confirmation URL)

features.name: Rooms API
features.description: Read-only list of the three seeded rooms (estandar 2 guests 180000 COP, superior 3 guests 250000 COP, suite-aurora 4 guests 420000 COP per night)

endpoints.description: List rooms with id, slug, nombre, descripcion, capacidad and tarifaNocheCop

features.name: Reservations API
features.description: Creates and reads reservations. Validation rules (same on client and server) are check-in today or later in America/Bogota, check-out after check-in, at most 30 nights, nombre 3 to 80 characters, valid email, celular exactly 10 digits starting with 3, huespedes between 1 and the room capacity. noches = days between check-in and check-out; totalCop = noches x nightly rate. Only CONFIRMADA reservations block dates; two stays overlap when newCheckIn < existingCheckOut and newCheckOut > existingCheckIn

endpoints.description: List reservations with their room, newest first
Create a reservation in estado PENDIENTE_PAGO with noches, totalCop and referencia AUR-<YYYYMMDD>-<6 uppercase letters or digits>

response_schema.400: { "errors": { "<field>": "<message>" } } for invalid fields, or { "error": "<message>" } when the body is not JSON
response_schema.404: { "error": "Habitación no encontrada" } for an unknown roomSlug
response_schema.409: { "error": "La habitación ya tiene una reserva confirmada en esas fechas" } when a CONFIRMADA reservation of the same room overlaps

endpoints.description: Read one reservation by its cuid id, including the room

features.name: PayU confirmation webhook
features.description: Server-to-server confirmation from PayU. Accepts application/x-www-form-urlencoded fields merchant_id, reference_sale, value, currency, state_pol, sign and transaction_id. The signature is the lowercase MD5 hex of apiKey~merchant_id~reference_sale~new_value~currency~state_pol, where apiKey is the public PayU Colombia sandbox key 4Vj8eK4rloUd272L48hsrarnUA, merchant_id must be 508029, and new_value is value with one decimal when the second decimal is zero (180000.00 becomes 180000.0) or with both decimals otherwise (150.25 stays 150.25). state_pol 4 sets the reservation to CONFIRMADA, 5 and 6 set PAGO_RECHAZADO, any other value changes nothing. This is also the way to obtain a CONFIRMADA reservation for testing the 409 rule of POST /api/reservations.

endpoints.description: Verify the signature, find the reservation by reference_sale, store transaction_id and update the status

response_schema.400: text error when the body is not form data
response_schema.403: text Firma inválida when the signature or merchant_id does not match; nothing changes
response_schema.404: text Reserva no encontrada when no reservation has that reference

known_limitations.issue: The 409 overlap check and the insert are not in one transaction
known_limitations.impact: Two simultaneous requests for the same dates could both pass the check

known_limitations.issue: Signatures use MD5 because it is PayU's default scheme
known_limitations.impact: Weaker than the SHA-256 or HMAC-SHA256 schemes PayU also accepts
